_about: Glaze recipe search, colour match (card G, multimodal_experiments/mm/glaze_retrieval.py). Restart RUN_GLAZE_SEARCH.bat after a change.
_model_dir: folder of glaze_retrieval_catalog.csv, glaze_retrieval_vectors.npz, shared_space_heads.pt (INSTALL_GLAZE_MODEL.bat fills it); relative = project folder
_weights: Ranking weights: latent similarity, CIEDE2000 colour, surface, cone - nonnegative, sum 1
_max_per_cluster: Explore formulations: at most this many recipes per K-Means chemistry cluster (notebook: 2)
_cone_scoring: orton = 04 is low fire and the original 7k cone text is used (default); notebook = the notebook's parser and catalog cones exactly (04 -> 4)
_allowed_splits: null = the whole catalog, as in the notebook demo; e.g. ["test"] for a held-out evaluation
